usage: xo fmt [--check] [--json] [files or dirs...]

Rewrite .xo files in the one canonical layout (core 10.5; no options)
and print the names of the files changed. --check changes nothing, lists
the unformatted files, and exits 1 if there are any. Files with syntax
errors are reported and left alone (exit 1). Default: .

A directory means that directory alone; DIR/... covers the directories
below it too, up to 6,000 .xo files or 60,000 entries (decision 0345).
A DIR/... with no .xo file at or below DIR is an error.
